title: Footprints Led to the Farm. None Led Away.

lines.text: Footprints in the snow led to the farm. None led away.
Bavaria, March 1922. A lonely farm called Hinterkaifeck.
The farmer, Andreas Gruber, reportedly told neighbours about the tracks.
He'd heard footsteps in the attic. He searched. Nobody.
A Munich newspaper turned up that nobody had bought.
Then a house key went missing.
Their previous maid had already quit. She'd heard noises in the attic too.
On March thirty-first, the new maid arrived. Her first day.
That night, all six people on the farm were killed.
No one found them for four days.
And that's where it gets stranger.
Neighbours later said smoke rose from the chimney in those days.
Someone had been feeding the cattle.
Investigators concluded the killer stayed on the farm for days.
Police looked at more than a hundred suspects. Nobody was ever convicted.
In 2007, police students re-examined the files with modern methods.
They reportedly narrowed it to one main suspect, but never named that person publicly.
Officially, the case is still unsolved.
Why would anyone stay? Tell me what you think.
And it all began in the snow.

shots.environment: other:snow field at forest edge, night
shots.description: Frame 1 already moving: ground-level view of a single line of boot prints (lib_murder.trail + print_decals, step 0.75 m, larger oval boot prints rx 0.09 ry 0.2, depth 0.06) running from a dark conifer tree line toward a barn wall with one lit window in the far background. Snow surface on either side is untouched. On 'None led away' the camera has reached the barn end: the prints stop at the wall; the snow beside them, back toward the trees, is clean.
shots.camera: ground-level dolly forward along the prints, 28mm, starts mid-move, slight rise at end to reveal the barn wall; handheld amp 0.015
shots.lighting: cold blue moonlight (sun 0.35, colour 0.5/0.6/1.0), night_sky stars 0.6; one warm lit window (emission 3.0, 1.0/0.7/0.4)

shots.description: Map card over a darkened, blurred plate of the farmstead: stylised outline of Bavaria, route line draws north from Munich, pin drops on Hinterkaifeck (between Ingolstadt and Schrobenhausen). Date stamp types on.
shots.camera: 2D overlay; background plate slow zoom 3%
shots.lighting: background plate dim blue

shots.description: Farmstead set (build once, reuse): house = studio_lib house_exterior (two-storey gabled, 9x7 m, roof dusted with mat_dusted), barn = attached L-wing gabled box 14x7x5 m (dark wood plank material, mat_dusted roof, large double door), ground = heightfield with mat_snow, conifer_forest band 80 m behind, bare deciduous trees near yard. Wide establishing shot at night: the farmhouse and barn alone in a snowy clearing, forest behind, one lit window. A faceless char_figure silhouette in a long coat (the farmer, never shown in detail) stands at the yard gate facing a second silhouette at the fence line (a neighbour), both tiny in frame. No faces.
shots.camera: slow push-in, 50mm, from 60 m; figures lower third
shots.lighting: cold blue moonlight (sun 0.35, colour 0.5/0.6/1.0), night_sky stars 0.6; one warm lit window (emission 3.0, 1.0/0.7/0.4); lantern point light (warm, 40 W) at the gate

shots.description: Attic: studio_lib room 8x5 m with the ceiling replaced by two sloped roof planes meeting at a ridge beam, exposed rafters (boxes 0.1x0.15 m every 0.8 m), hay bales (rounded boxes) and dust. A flashlight cone sweeps from the hatch in the floor across empty boards. On 'Nobody' the beam stops on an empty corner. Dust falls from a rafter as a creak plays.
shots.camera: POV from floor hatch, 24mm, handheld amp 0.03, slow pan left to right
shots.lighting: darkness + flashlight spot (warm, 900 W, 22 deg) from camera; faint moonlight slits between roof boards

shots.description: Document reveal: a folded newspaper slides onto a dark wood kitchen table (lib_murder.desk + mat_wood_dark) under a single oil-lamp glow; overlay shows a generic masthead. No real newspaper name or real article text is reproduced.
shots.camera: top-down 50mm, slow rotate 4 deg
shots.lighting: warm oil-lamp point light (60 W) + deep shadow

overlay.text:
A Munich paper.
No one on the farm had bought it.

shots.description: Close-up of an old wooden door with an iron lock plate; beside it a wall hook with two key outlines painted on the board but only ONE iron key hanging (key prop: torus bow + cylinder shaft + box bit). Camera racks focus to the empty outline.
shots.camera: static close-up 85mm with rack focus from key to empty outline
shots.lighting: moonlight through a window (cold), single warm practical off-frame

shots.description: A small faceless female silhouette (char_figure, shawl) with a bundle walks away from the farm down a snowy lane between bare trees; the lit farmhouse recedes behind her. Represents the previous maid leaving (earlier; date not specified on screen).
shots.camera: locked wide 35mm behind the figure, figure walks away from camera
characters: previous maid silhouette (char_figure, shawl, bundle) - anim_walk
shots.lighting: cold blue moonlight (sun 0.35, colour 0.5/0.6/1.0), night_sky stars 0.6; one warm lit window (emission 3.0, 1.0/0.7/0.4)

shots.description: Late afternoon, overcast: a different small silhouette with a suitcase (lib_murder.suitcase) walks TOWARD the farmhouse gate. Calendar overlay stamps 31 MARCH 1922.
shots.camera: slow lateral track 35mm, figure crosses frame left to right toward the gate
characters: new maid silhouette (char_figure, coat, suitcase) - anim_walk
shots.lighting: dim grey dusk (dawn_sky preset, low strength 0.4), house windows warm

overlay.text:
FRIDAY 31 MARCH 1922
THE NEW MAID'S FIRST DAY

shots.description: RESPECT BEAT. Same wide farm view as S03, now full night. The lit window goes dark (lamp off). Nothing else happens. No figures, no violence, no implied action. Hold.
shots.camera: locked-off wide 50mm, no movement
shots.lighting: cold blue moonlight (sun 0.35, colour 0.5/0.6/1.0), night_sky stars 0.6; one warm lit window (emission 3.0, 1.0/0.7/0.4); window emission animates 3.0 -> 0 at 1.2 s (flicker off, 2 flickers)

shots.description: Timeline overlay over a dim plate of the dark farmhouse: FRI 31 MAR -> SAT -> SUN -> MON -> TUE 4 APR (found). Days tick by.
shots.camera: 2D overlay; background slow lateral pan
shots.lighting: background dim blue

shots.description: MID-POINT TURN. Fast push from wide toward the dark farmhouse roof and its chimney. Hard flash at the start.
shots.camera: fast push-in 35mm -> 85mm crash zoom on the chimney, ends tight
shots.lighting: cold blue moonlight (sun 0.35, colour 0.5/0.6/1.0), night_sky stars 0.6; one warm lit window (emission 3.0, 1.0/0.7/0.4)

shots.description: Grey daylight, a few days later: the house and barn in thin snow; a thin column of smoke rises from the chimney (volume_puff chain / smoke particle stream, grey). Two tiny silhouettes on the road in the foreground stop and look (visitors).
shots.camera: slow tilt up from road to chimney, 50mm
shots.lighting: flat overcast day (sky grey-blue, sun 0.8 soft)

shots.description: Barn interior: wooden stalls (boxes), low-poly cattle silhouettes (body = rounded box, head box, four cylinder legs; dark brown) calmly eating; a trough freshly filled with hay. No people, nothing else in the barn shown. Only the stall row and the trough are in frame.
shots.camera: slow dolly along the trough, 35mm, trough edge in foreground
shots.lighting: grey daylight through plank gaps (volumetric shafts), dust

shots.description: Evidence board (lib_murder.evidence_board) under a hanging lamp: three paper cards slam in one by one: SMOKE / CATTLE FED / BREAD EATEN, joined by red string to a central card: 'SOMEONE STAYED'.
shots.camera: slow push-in 50mm; tiny shake on each slam (lib_murder.shake)
shots.lighting: single warm hanging lamp (220 W), dark surround

overlay.text:
Investigators concluded the perpetrator
remained at the farm for several days

shots.description: Same board, wider: dozens of blank grey suspect cards (no names, no faces; question-mark glyph only) fill the board; a counter climbs to 100+. A red rubber stamp hits: NO CONVICTION.
shots.camera: pull back 50mm -> 35mm revealing the full board
shots.lighting: hanging lamp + cold fill

shots.description: Desk scene (lib_murder.desk, desk_lamp): a thick case-file folder opens; a modern laptop-shaped box with glowing screen sits beside old yellowed papers (paper_card props). Stamp '2007'.
shots.camera: slow overhead push 50mm
shots.lighting: desk lamp warm + cold screen glow

shots.description: Back to the board: all grey suspect cards slide away except ONE, which stays face-down. A sheet of black paper slides over it. No name ever appears.
shots.camera: push-in to the single card, 85mm
shots.lighting: lamp narrows to a spot on the single card

overlay.text:
Not publicly named
(out of respect for relatives, per reports)

shots.description: Respect card: a simple stone memorial (lib_murder.headstone, kind 0, plus a thin iron cross on top) stands in snow at the edge of the field, a small lantern beside it. Memorial overlay with the six names.
shots.camera: slow push-in 50mm
shots.lighting: lantern warm point light + moonlight

overlay.text:
Andreas & Cäzilia Gruber
Viktoria Gabriel, Cäzilia & Josef
Maria Baumgartner

shots.description: Wide night shot of the farm from the forest edge, behind a tree trunk in foreground (the point of view of the tracks' origin). The barn is dark. Question text holds.
shots.camera: slow push from behind tree trunk, 35mm
shots.lighting: cold blue moonlight (sun 0.35, colour 0.5/0.6/1.0), night_sky stars 0.6; all windows dark (emission 3.0, 1.0/0.7/0.4)

shots.environment: other:snow field at forest edge, night
shots.description: LOOP FRAME: framing, lighting and dolly identical to S01's first frame (ground level at the first prints by the tree line) so the cut back to frame 1 is seamless.
shots.camera: matches S01 start, dolly forward
shots.lighting: as S01
